prompt: At a busy fishing harbor at dawn, mist hangs low over the wet wooden docks. In the foreground, a fisherman in yellow rubber boots pulls a heavy net filled with silvery fish onto the planks, assisted by a younger deckhand in a blue jacket. To their left, a crate of ice sits open, with another worker shoveling ice over freshly caught cod. A seagull perches on a nearby bollard, eyeing the catch closely. On the right, a woman in a pink raincoat inspects a lobster held by a vendor wearing a wool sweater. Behind them, several fishing boats with peeling paint are moored, their masts reflecting in the calm water. A rusty winch stands idle near the edge of the dock. The lighting is soft and cool, with the rising sun casting long, pale orange reflections on the water surface. Wet surfaces glisten with moisture, enhancing the realism of the scene. The sky is a gradient of purple and pink, indicating early morning. This image is a photorealistic photo with high resolution, capturing every droplet of water and scale on the fish with meticulous clarity and natural color balance.
